question: Tampilkan lima pelanggan dari Brasil berdasarkan ID.
expected_sql: SELECT CustomerId, FirstName, LastName FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil' ORDER BY CustomerId LIMIT 5

question: List the first five customers from the USA by customer ID.
expected_sql: SELECT CustomerId, FirstName, LastName FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'USA' ORDER BY CustomerId LIMIT 5

question: Tampilkan lima track bergenre ID 1.
expected_sql: SELECT TrackId, Name, GenreId FROM Track WHERE GenreId = 1 ORDER BY TrackId LIMIT 5
expected_rows: For Those About To Rock (We Salute You)

question: Show five 0.99-priced tracks whose composer is missing.
expected_sql: SELECT TrackId, Name, UnitPrice FROM Track WHERE UnitPrice = 0.99 AND Composer IS NULL ORDER BY TrackId LIMIT 5
expected_rows: Samba De Uma Nota Só (One Note Samba)

question: Tampilkan lima invoice yang ditagihkan ke Jerman.
expected_sql: SELECT InvoiceId, CustomerId, Total FROM Invoice WHERE BillingCountry = 'Germany' ORDER BY InvoiceId LIMIT 5

question: List invoices with totals of at least 10, highest total first.
expected_sql: SELECT InvoiceId, CustomerId, Total FROM Invoice WHERE Total >= 10 ORDER BY Total DESC, InvoiceId LIMIT 5

question: Tampilkan karyawan yang jabatannya mengandung kata Sales.
expected_sql: SELECT EmployeeId, FirstName, LastName, Title FROM Employee WHERE Title LIKE '%Sales%' ORDER BY EmployeeId

question: Tampilkan lima pelanggan yang didukung karyawan ID 3.
expected_sql: SELECT CustomerId, FirstName, LastName, SupportRepId FROM Customer WHERE SupportRepId = 3 ORDER BY CustomerId LIMIT 5

question: List invoices billed in Paris.
expected_sql: SELECT InvoiceId, BillingCity, Total FROM Invoice WHERE BillingCity = 'Paris' ORDER BY InvoiceId

question: Tampilkan genre yang namanya diawali huruf R.
expected_sql: SELECT GenreId, Name FROM Genre WHERE Name LIKE 'R%' ORDER BY GenreId

question: List media types whose name contains audio.
expected_sql: SELECT MediaTypeId, Name FROM MediaType WHERE Name LIKE '%audio%' ORDER BY MediaTypeId

question: Tampilkan playlist yang namanya mengandung Music.
expected_sql: SELECT PlaylistId, Name FROM Playlist WHERE Name LIKE '%Music%' ORDER BY PlaylistId

question: Show tracks with a missing byte size.
expected_sql: SELECT TrackId, Name, Bytes FROM Track WHERE Bytes IS NULL ORDER BY TrackId LIMIT 5

question: Tampilkan pelanggan dari Kanada atau Prancis.
expected_sql: SELECT CustomerId, FirstName, LastName, Country FROM Customer WHERE Country IN ('Canada', 'France') ORDER BY Country, CustomerId LIMIT 10

question: Hitung seluruh pelanggan.
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(CustomerId) AS customer_count FROM Customer

question: Count all invoices.
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(InvoiceId) AS invoice_count FROM Invoice

question: Hitung total pendapatan seluruh invoice.
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS total_revenue FROM Invoice

question: Calculate the average invoice total.
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(Total), 2) AS average_invoice_total FROM Invoice

question: Berapa harga track minimum dan maksimum?
expected_sql: SELECT MIN(UnitPrice) AS minimum_price, MAX(UnitPrice) AS maximum_price FROM Track

question: Count tracks for each genre ID.
expected_sql: SELECT GenreId, COUNT(TrackId) AS track_count FROM Track GROUP BY GenreId ORDER BY GenreId

question: Hitung album untuk setiap artist ID.
expected_sql: SELECT ArtistId, COUNT(AlbumId) AS album_count FROM Album GROUP BY ArtistId ORDER BY ArtistId

question: Tampilkan nilai invoice minimum dan maksimum.
expected_sql: SELECT MIN(Total) AS minimum_total, MAX(Total) AS maximum_total FROM Invoice

question: Count customers that have a company value.
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(CustomerId) AS company_customer_count FROM Customer WHERE Company IS NOT NULL

question: Jumlahkan nilai invoice per negara penagihan tanpa menentukan urutan.
expected_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry

question: Count all genres.
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(GenreId) AS genre_count FROM Genre

question: Hitung semua playlist.
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(PlaylistId) AS playlist_count FROM Playlist

question: Count all invoice lines.
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(InvoiceLineId) AS invoice_line_count FROM InvoiceLine

question: Hitung rata-rata harga unit baris invoice.
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(UnitPrice), 2) AS average_line_price FROM InvoiceLine

question: Tampilkan lima invoice beserta nama pelanggannya.
expected_sql: SELECT i.InvoiceId, c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, i.Total FROM Invoice AS i JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId ORDER BY i.InvoiceId LIMIT 5

question: Show five invoice lines with their invoice totals.
expected_sql: SELECT il.InvoiceLineId, il.InvoiceId, il.UnitPrice, il.Quantity, i.Total FROM InvoiceLine AS il JOIN Invoice AS i ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId ORDER BY il.InvoiceLineId LIMIT 5

question: Tampilkan lima track beserta nama genrenya.
expected_sql: SELECT t.TrackId, t.Name AS track_name, g.Name AS genre_name FROM Track AS t JOIN Genre AS g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId ORDER BY t.TrackId LIMIT 5
expected_rows: For Those About To Rock (We Salute You)

question: List five albums with artist names.
expected_sql: SELECT al.AlbumId, al.Title, ar.Name AS artist_name FROM Album AS al JOIN Artist AS ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId ORDER BY al.AlbumId LIMIT 5
expected_rows: For Those About To Rock We Salute You

question: Tampilkan lima track beserta judul albumnya.
expected_sql: SELECT t.TrackId, t.Name AS track_name, al.Title AS album_title FROM Track AS t JOIN Album AS al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId ORDER BY t.TrackId LIMIT 5
expected_rows: For Those About To Rock (We Salute You)
For Those About To Rock We Salute You

question: List five tracks with their media type names.
expected_sql: SELECT t.TrackId, t.Name AS track_name, m.Name AS media_type FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId ORDER BY t.TrackId LIMIT 5
expected_rows: For Those About To Rock (We Salute You)

question: Tampilkan lima pelanggan beserta nama support rep.
expected_sql: SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, e.FirstName AS rep_first_name, e.LastName AS rep_last_name FROM Customer AS c JOIN Employee AS e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId ORDER BY c.CustomerId LIMIT 5

question: Hitung nilai penjualan baris invoice per negara penagihan.
expected_sql: SELECT i.BillingCountry, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS line_sales FROM Invoice AS i JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId GROUP BY i.BillingCountry ORDER BY line_sales DESC, i.BillingCountry

question: Calculate line sales for five artists, ordered by value.
expected_sql: SELECT ar.ArtistId, ar.Name, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS line_sales FROM Artist AS ar JOIN Album AS al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId JOIN Track AS t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY line_sales DESC, ar.ArtistId LIMIT 5

question: Hitung unit terjual untuk lima album teratas berdasarkan jumlah unit.
expected_sql: SELECT al.AlbumId, al.Title, SUM(il.Quantity) AS units_sold FROM Album AS al JOIN Track AS t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId GROUP BY al.AlbumId, al.Title ORDER BY units_sold DESC, al.AlbumId LIMIT 5

question: Sum units sold by genre.
expected_sql: SELECT g.GenreId, g.Name, SUM(il.Quantity) AS units_sold FROM Genre AS g JOIN Track AS t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY g.GenreId

question: Hitung pelanggan yang didukung setiap karyawan.
expected_sql: SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS customer_count FROM Employee AS e JOIN Customer AS c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName ORDER BY e.EmployeeId

question: Count invoices for five customers by customer ID.
expected_sql: SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, COUNT(i.InvoiceId) AS invoice_count FROM Customer AS c JOIN Invoice AS i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY c.CustomerId LIMIT 5

question: Hitung track untuk setiap tipe media.
expected_sql: SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count FROM MediaType AS m JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name ORDER BY m.MediaTypeId

question: Hitung invoice per bulan selama 2012.
expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS month, COUNT(InvoiceId) AS invoice_count FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2012-01-01' AND InvoiceDate < '2013-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: Calculate invoice revenue by calendar year.
expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS year, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

question: Hitung rata-rata nilai invoice per bulan kalender.
expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS month, ROUND(AVG(Total), 2) AS average_total FROM Invoice GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: Count invoices by day of week number.
expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%w', InvoiceDate) AS weekday, COUNT(InvoiceId) AS invoice_count FROM Invoice GROUP BY weekday ORDER BY weekday

question: Tampilkan tanggal invoice paling awal dan paling akhir.
expected_sql: SELECT MIN(InvoiceDate) AS first_invoice_date, MAX(InvoiceDate) AS last_invoice_date FROM Invoice

question: Calculate monthly invoice revenue during 2013.
expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS month, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2013-01-01' AND InvoiceDate < '2014-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: Hitung invoice berdasarkan nomor bulan untuk seluruh tahun.
expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%m', InvoiceDate) AS month_number, COUNT(InvoiceId) AS invoice_count FROM Invoice GROUP BY month_number ORDER BY month_number

question: Tampilkan tiga negara dengan pendapatan invoice tertinggi.
expected_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY revenue DESC, BillingCountry LIMIT 3

question: Show five customers with the most invoices.

question: Tampilkan lima genre dengan unit terjual terbanyak.
expected_sql: SELECT g.GenreId, g.Name, SUM(il.Quantity) AS units_sold FROM Genre AS g JOIN Track AS t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY units_sold DESC, g.GenreId LIMIT 5

question: List the five longest tracks in milliseconds.
expected_sql: SELECT TrackId, Name, Milliseconds FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC, TrackId LIMIT 5

question: Tampilkan lima artist dengan jumlah album terbanyak.
expected_sql: SELECT ar.ArtistId, ar.Name, COUNT(al.AlbumId) AS album_count FROM Artist AS ar JOIN Album AS al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY album_count DESC, ar.ArtistId LIMIT 5

question: Show five albums with the highest track counts.
expected_sql: SELECT al.AlbumId, al.Title, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Album AS al JOIN Track AS t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId GROUP BY al.AlbumId, al.Title ORDER BY track_count DESC, al.AlbumId LIMIT 5

question: Tampilkan tipe media dengan jumlah track terbanyak.
expected_sql: SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count FROM MediaType AS m JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name ORDER BY track_count DESC, m.MediaTypeId

question: Tampilkan lima invoice yang nilainya di atas rata-rata seluruh invoice.
expected_sql: SELECT InvoiceId, CustomerId, Total FROM Invoice WHERE Total > (SELECT AVG(Total) FROM Invoice) ORDER BY Total DESC, InvoiceId LIMIT 5

question: List five tracks longer than the average track duration.
expected_sql: SELECT TrackId, Name, Milliseconds FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > (SELECT AVG(Milliseconds) FROM Track) ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC, TrackId LIMIT 5

question: Tampilkan lima pelanggan yang total belanjanya di atas rata-rata total belanja pelanggan.
expected_sql: SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS total_spend FROM Customer AS c JOIN Invoice AS i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName HAVING SUM(i.Total) > (SELECT AVG(customer_total) FROM (SELECT SUM(Total) AS customer_total FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId)) ORDER BY total_spend DESC, c.CustomerId LIMIT 5

question: Show five albums whose track count is above the average album track count.
expected_sql: SELECT al.AlbumId, al.Title, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Album AS al JOIN Track AS t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId GROUP BY al.AlbumId, al.Title HAVING COUNT(t.TrackId) > (SELECT AVG(album_track_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(TrackId) AS album_track_count FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId)) ORDER BY track_count DESC, al.AlbumId LIMIT 5

question: Tampilkan lima artist yang memiliki track berharga lebih dari 1.5.
expected_sql: SELECT ar.ArtistId, ar.Name FROM Artist AS ar WHERE ar.ArtistId IN (SELECT al.ArtistId FROM Album AS al JOIN Track AS t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId WHERE t.UnitPrice > 1.5) ORDER BY ar.ArtistId LIMIT 5
